sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven mature man in three-quarter/profile view toward screen left, chin slightly lifted and eyes looking upward-left, with short very closely cropped gray/brown temple hair and restrained dark brows, no moustache, beard or eyeglasses. Light gray/white naval peaked cap with dark band, plain black visor, gold cord and mixed silver/gold anchor-style front emblem. Dark navy broad-lapel jacket over pale gray/white shirt and dark tie. Preserve closed stern mouth, cropped shoulder pose, directional lighting from upper left and complete muted gray-beige painted rectangular background. Tiny emblem internal strokes are unreadable; retain visible emblem shape without invented text.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven mature man in a slight three-quarter pose toward screen left wearing round thin metal-rim eyeglasses, with short dark side hair mostly hidden by a white naval peaked cap, dark brows and a restrained faint closed-mouth smile. White cap has a dark band, gold cord, gold leaf visor embroidery and a silver/gold anchor-style center emblem. Dark navy broad-lapel jacket over white shirt and black tie. Preserve pose, eyeglasses shape, near-frontal upward gaze, close bust crop, soft left lighting and complete muted gray-beige painted backing. No moustache or beard; small badge relief and individual spectacles reflections cannot be resolved exactly.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Young clean-shaven man with short brown hair mostly hidden under an asymmetrically tilted white/light gray naval peaked cap, brown eyebrows and blue eyes looking slightly upward toward screen right, neutral closed lips and no glasses, moustache or beard. Cap has a dark band, black visor, narrow gold cord and a silver/gold front anchor-style badge. Dark navy open-lapel coat over pale gray shirt and black tie. Retain the slight three-quarter angle, cap tilt, cropped bust and complete softly mottled gray-beige painted background with directional light from upper left. Fine badge relief is too small to identify reliably.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Mature woman with neatly arranged light brown/gray-blond hair, center/side-parted waves rolled over both temples and swept into a low braided/coiled gathering behind the neck. Fine arched brown brows, serious composed expression with a slight closed-lip pout, three-quarter head toward screen left, eyes toward viewer. Deep purple tailored blouse/jacket with closely spaced horizontal pleats, diagonal lapel edging, center dark buttons and a high pale gray-lavender neck scarf fastened by a large pale flower/bow at the throat. Preserve the original hair volume, stern expression, bust crop, subdued left lighting and full dark charcoal-to-gray rectangular painted background. No hat or eyeglasses. Tiny flower folds and button relief are visible only as broad shapes; do not replace the scarf with a yellow neck or cream belly.

finalizer_source.source:
"""Finish the root b finite-group bookkeeping after actual source completion."""
import json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
tag=sys.argv[1]
assert re.fullmatch(r'fresh-observed-20261025T[0-9]{6}-b-[0-9a-f]{8}',tag)
phase_path=ROOT/'runtime/root-b-review-v6-phase.json';phase=read_json(phase_path)
assert phase['machine_id']==machine_id() and phase['current_kind']=='originals' and phase['current_tag']==tag
assert phase['completed_groups']<phase['max_groups']
receipt=ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-fresh-observation-completions/{tag}.json';done=read_json(receipt)
assert done['machine_id']==machine_id() and done['slot']=='b' and done['queued_originals']==4 and done['held_originals']==0
assert done['image_calls']==0 and done['quota_claims']==0
observations=ROOT/done['observations'];assert file_sha256(observations)==done['observations_sha256']
target=ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-review-handovers/20261025-root-{tag}.json';assert not target.exists()
phase['completed_groups']+=1;phase.update(current_tag=None,current_kind=None,updated_at_utc=utc_now())
phase.setdefault('completed',[]).append({'tag':tag,'kind':'originals','completion':receipt.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'completion_sha256':file_sha256(receipt),'completed_at_utc':done['completed_at_utc']})
write_json(target,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'operator':'Codex root in existing b slot; b agent stopped','completion':done,'completion_sha256':file_sha256(receipt),'actual_source_observations':read_json(observations),'finite_phase_after_completion':phase,'finalizer_source':{'path':Path(__file__).relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':file_sha256(Path(__file__)),'source':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')},'scope':'Source observation completion already succeeded once. Only finite root b phase bookkeeping is updated here; no art approval, image call, retry or canonical portrait mutation.'})
write_json(phase_path,phase)
print(json.dumps({'tag':tag,'completed_groups':phase['completed_groups'],'audit':target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()},ensure_ascii=True))
